title: MORE Words and Phrases
source: User-provided cropped workbook photo, partial table transcription

entries.example: Cartoons are my favourite programme.
entries.description: A funny film with drawings, like Mickey Mouse

entries.example: Every day we have three hours of screen time.
entries.description: The hours you spend in front of a TV, computer or phone

entries.example: What's the news headline today?
entries.description: The big title of a story in a newspaper

entries.example: This is their latest song.
entries.description: The newest

entries.example: We also watch comedy series.
entries.description: A funny film or TV show that makes you laugh

entries.example: I watch three episodes a day.
entries.description: One part of a TV series

entries.example: I watch the gamers.
entries.description: A person who spends a lot of time with computer or video fun

entries.example: I usually watch some kind of series.
entries.description: A type of: Pizza is a ___ food from Italy.

entries.example: I quite like detective films.
entries.description: Not very, but more than a little: It's ___ good.

entries.example: We sometimes stream a film.
entries.description: To watch a film online without downloading it

entries.example: Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.
entries.description: Saturday and Sunday

entries.example: The film stopped and the people in the picture froze.
entries.description: To stop and not move at all

entries.example: An elephant is a huge animal.
entries.description: Very, very big

entries.example: Inside the car, there were four people.
entries.description: In a house or a room, not outside

entries.example: I paid three pounds for my hamburger.
entries.description: To give money for something you buy

entries.example: She pointed to the clock inside the bank.
entries.description: To show something with your finger

entries.example: It has special powers.
entries.description: Strength, or a special magic ability

entries.example: You use a remote control to change the programme.
entries.description: You use this to change the programme on TV

entries.example: I replied to your email this morning.
entries.description: To answer a letter or an email

entries.example: He wants to sell his old car.
entries.description: The opposite of buy

entries.example: An ant is an insect.
entries.description: Very, very small

entries.example: She's a great singer with a beautiful voice.
entries.description: The sound you make when you speak or sing

entries.example: There's a very wide road near our house.
entries.description: The opposite of narrow

entries.example: He fought his sister to get the control.
entries.description: To hit and kick each other

entries.example: The shopkeeper wasn't there.
entries.description: The person who owns a small shop

entries.example: He turned the ring and disappeared.
entries.description: To go away so nobody can see you any more

entries.example: The robber held a gun in his hand.
entries.description: To have something in your hand

entries.example: We spend a lot of time watching shows.
entries.description: To use time doing something: We ___ a lot of time online.

entries.example: Bend down and hug me.
entries.description: To move your body lower to get close to the ground

entries.example: Can I hug you?
entries.description: To put your arms around someone you love

entries.example: The giraffe went to the lake.
entries.description: A big area of water with land all around it

entries.example: It only eats leaves.
entries.description: A green part of a tree; it falls in autumn

entries.example: I want to lie in the sun.
entries.description: To be flat on a bed or on the beach

entries.example: The lion's skin is yellow.
entries.description: The outside of your body

entries.example: The giraffe has black spots.
entries.description: A small round mark, like on a leopard

entries.example: I feel so weak today.
entries.description: The opposite of strong

entries.example: Maybe I'm dead tomorrow.
entries.description: Not alive

entries.example: Once upon a time, there was a lion.
entries.description: How fairy tales start

entries.example: One day, the giraffe went to the lake.
entries.description: In a story: on a day in the past (two words)

entries.example: My favourite books are adventure stories.
entries.description: An exciting and sometimes dangerous experience

entries.example: Look at the book covers.
entries.description: The front and back of a book

entries.example: Is this a story about friendship?
entries.description: When two people are friends

entries.example: I read a poem every day.
entries.description: A short text with lines that often rhyme

entries.example: The neighbour's kid is nice.
entries.description: A person who lives next door
